metadata.title: Olaparib (Tablet) and Bevacizumab Therapy
metadata.indication: First-line maintenance of HRD-positive advanced ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer after response to platinum therapy.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Current source reconciled; independent clinical approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP 00746 v2 and current EMA Lynparza/Avastin safety information. Decisions are component-specific; unresolved dose-source differences remain visible.

metadata.schedule_summary: Olaparib 300 mg orally twice daily continuously plus bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV every 21 days. Olaparib: up to 2 years if disease-free, with an individual residual-disease decision; bevacizumab: maximum 15 months total including chemotherapy.

contexts.source_schedule_interval_label: Olaparib continuously twice daily + bevacizumab every 21 days
contexts.duration_text: Olaparib: stop at 2 years if no radiological disease; longer only for residual disease with clinical benefit. Bevacizumab: up to 15 months total including prior chemotherapy. Stop earlier for progression/toxicity.

display.duration: Olaparib: stop at 2 years if no radiological disease; longer only for residual disease with clinical benefit. Bevacizumab: up to 15 months total including prior chemotherapy. Stop earlier for progression/toxicity.
display.cycle_interval: Olaparib continuously twice daily + bevacizumab every 21 days

provenance.source_verification: HSE original PDF retrieved and checked on 24 November 2026.
provenance.note: Olaparib and bevacizumab have independent treatment clocks. The bevacizumab maximum of 15 months includes the preceding chemotherapy-combination period and does not restart at maintenance. The olaparib two-year decision allows continuation only where residual disease and clinical benefit remain; progression or unacceptable toxicity can stop either agent earlier. The 21-day infusion/review interval does not create olaparib rest days or a fixed number of maintenance cycles. Independent clinical and oncology-pharmacy authorisation remains pending.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Discuss dose changes with the Consultant. There is no bevacizumab dose-reduction ladder; retain separate olaparib and bevacizumab decisions.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision support does not replace the current NCCP protocol, authorised prescription, oncology-pharmacy verification or clinical judgement.

indications.description: First-line maintenance for adults with FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial ovarian, fallopian-tube or primary-peritoneal cancer in complete or partial response after platinum chemotherapy with bevacizumab and validated HRD positivity (BRCA1/2 mutation and/or genomic instability).

treatment.schedule_summary: Olaparib 300 mg orally twice daily continuously plus bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV every 21 days. Olaparib: up to 2 years if disease-free, with an individual residual-disease decision; bevacizumab: maximum 15 months total including chemotherapy.

administration_instructions: Do not chew, crush, dissolve, or divide.
May be taken with or without food.
If a dose is missed, take the next normal dose at the scheduled time.

bevacizumab.dilution: 100 mL sodium chloride 0.9%; confirm selected product preparation instructions
bevacizumab.administration_note: No intravenous bolus. Prior bevacizumab during chemotherapy counts when assessing tolerance and total duration.

anc_x10e9_l.label: ANC
anc_x10e9_l.source_grading_note: NCCP Table 2, page 6, specifies numerical treatment-action thresholds, not a named CTCAE grading version. ANC below 1 OR platelets below 100 requires delay until recovery and review of a reduced olaparib dose; the fourth qualifying occurrence requires cessation.

haematological_toxicity_occurrence_numbe.label: Haematological toxicity occurrence number
haematological_toxicity_occurrence_numbe.help: Cumulative qualifying count/FN occurrence; the fourth requires cessation. A missing number does not block an immediate count-based hold.

febrile_neutropenia.label: Febrile neutropenia
febrile_neutropenia.assessment_guidance: Use the same CTCAE v5 reference as the linked grade selector: ANC below 1 ×10⁹/L with a single temperature above 38.3°C or at least 38°C sustained for more than one hour. Urgently assess suspected sepsis; NCCP requires interruption for febrile neutropenia regardless of whether the severity selector has been completed.

febrile_neutropenia_grade.label: Febrile neutropenia grade
febrile_neutropenia_grade.help: Required only when febrile neutropenia is present.
febrile_neutropenia_grade.assessment_guidance: Confirm ANC and temperature criteria, assess sepsis, haemodynamic stability, organ dysfunction and need for urgent IV antimicrobial treatment.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: ANC below 1.0 ×10⁹/L with either a single temperature above 38.3°C or at least 38.0°C sustained for more than one hour.

crcl_ml_min.label: Creatinine clearance category
crcl_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Select the band for verified creatinine clearance in mL/min. Record the renal calculation and date; do not relabel an indexed eGFR in mL/min/1.73 m² as CrCl. Exactly 30 mL/min needs explicit NCCP/SmPC reconciliation.
crcl_ml_min.help: Use verified creatinine clearance, not an interchangeable unadjusted eGFR. Exact30 is a source discrepancy. Numeric input remains supported.

haemodialysis.label: Patient receiving haemodialysis
haemodialysis.help: Required only in severe renal impairment to distinguish haemodialysis.

child_pugh_class.label: Child–Pugh class
child_pugh_class.help: Optional hepatic-impairment review. Leaving this blank is recorded as an unassessed domain.

cyp3a_inhibitor_class.label: CYP3A inhibitor class
cyp3a_inhibitor_class.help: Optional interaction review. Complete when a relevant interacting medicine is present or suspected.

persistent_cytopenia_after_4_week_hold.label: Counts remain abnormal after four weeks off olaparib

intolerable_nonhaematological_toxicity.label: Intolerable nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or other toxicity

recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.label: Before initial treatment: previous blood toxicity recovered to grade 1 or better
recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.help: Initial-start requirement from EMA SmPC. Do not use the less restrictive on-treatment count threshold to infer recovery.
recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.grading_source_label: EMA Lynparza SmPC — initial blood-toxicity recovery
recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.source_grading_note: SmPC section 4.4 requires recovery to CTCAE grade 1 or better before initial treatment, but does not name a CTCAE version here. Confirm the named cytopenia and the source grading version; generic severity anchors cannot establish recovery.
recovered_previous_haematological_toxici.assessment_guidance: Before starting olaparib, confirm that haemoglobin, platelets and neutrophils have recovered from prior anticancer treatment to CTCAE grade 1 or better. A passing NCCP on-treatment ANC/platelet threshold does not establish this initial-start requirement.

hb_g_dl.label: Haemoglobin
hb_g_dl.help: Enter g/dL (divide g/L by 10). Severe or transfusion-dependent anaemia needs interruption and investigation; this is not a transfusion-prescribing calculator.
hb_g_dl.assessment_guidance: Use CTCAE v5 anaemia grading, matching the encoded Hb rules: below 8 g/dL is grade 3, 8 to below 10 g/dL is grade 2, and grade 1 requires the local lower limit of normal. Transfusion indication or life-threatening consequences can assign a higher grade. This is not a transfusion-prescribing threshold or whole-patient clearance.

renal_measurement_context.label: Renal result used for olaparib

options.label: Indexed eGFR, other measure or method not confirmed

renal_measurement_context.assessment_guidance: Use verified creatinine clearance. An indexed eGFR in mL/min/1.73 m² is not an interchangeable CrCl value. Record the method and date in the clinical record.

bevacizumab_total_months_including_chemo.assessment_guidance: Count the earlier bevacizumab/chemotherapy period. Do not restart the 15-month clock when maintenance begins.

urine_protein_dipstick.label: Urine protein dipstick
urine_protein_dipstick.source_grading_note: This is a urine screening result, not a CTCAE grade or a 24-hour protein amount.
urine_protein_dipstick.assessment_guidance: This is a urine screening result, not a CTCAE grade or a 24-hour protein amount.

urine_protein_g_l.label: Laboratory urine protein concentration
urine_protein_g_l.assessment_guidance: A spot concentration in g/L must not be converted to total grams per 24 hours without an actual timed collection.

protein_24h_g.label: Total protein in an actual 24-hour urine collection
protein_24h_g.assessment_guidance: NCCP Table 4: ≤2 g/24 h allows the scheduled dose in this domain; >2–4 holds; >4 stops bevacizumab. Do not enter a spot g/L concentration here.

grade4_proteinuria.label: Clinically assessed grade 4 proteinuria under the NCCP severe-toxicity pathway
grade4_proteinuria.source_grading_note: Preserve the grade-4 action stated in the NCCP table. This is not dipstick 4+, and no CTCAE grade is inferred from urine quantity.
grade4_proteinuria.assessment_guidance: Preserve the grade-4 action stated in the NCCP table. This is not dipstick 4+, and no CTCAE grade is inferred from urine quantity.

hypertension_control.label: Clinical blood-pressure control assessment
hypertension_control.assessment_guidance: Interpret repeated readings, symptoms and antihypertensive treatment together. NCCP initiation caution describes sustained >150/100 on antihypertensive medication without defining a numerical AND/OR rule.

hypertension_grade.label: Clinically assessed hypertension grade
hypertension_grade.source_grading_note: Use the clinically assessed adverse-event grade in NCCP 00746 Table 5. The NCCP table does not name a grading edition; no grade is inferred from a single numeric reading or a generic descriptor.

bevacizumab_caution_requires_review.label: Relevant cardiovascular, bleeding, thrombosis, prior-radiation or fistula-risk caution needs review
bevacizumab_caution_requires_review.assessment_guidance: NCCP cautions include significant cardiovascular disease, bleeding/coagulation problems, VTE history, arterial thromboembolism within six months, prior pelvic/chest-wall irradiation or anthracycline exposure, renal/proteinuria problems, and procedures/conditions increasing perforation or fistula risk. A caution is not automatically a permanent contraindication.

output_templates.proceed: Entered criteria meet the encoded domain thresholds; omitted information remains unassessed.
output_templates.consultant_review: Review the source-linked concern with the Consultant and oncology pharmacist.
output_templates.delay_then_dose_reduce: Interrupt olaparib now. Recovery, previous dose and occurrence history determine any subsequent restart.
output_templates.contraindicated: An NCCP exclusion or product contraindication was entered. Do not administer.
output_templates.withhold: Interrupt or do not start olaparib pending investigation of the entered concern.
output_templates.cease: NCCP specifies cessation in this circumstance.
output_templates.permanently_discontinue: The source specifies discontinuation; arrange appropriate specialist care.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Display every source-linked finding; the most restrictive action governs. Source conflicts suppress automatic numeric doses.

action.message: The entered ANC and platelet values meet NCCP on-treatment thresholds. Continue the previous prescribed dose only if other assessed domains permit; this does not reset an existing reduction.

action.message: Delay olaparib for ANC <1 or platelets <100 ×10⁹/L until recovery, then restart one level lower per NCCP Table 1. Check prior reductions and occurrence history; the fourth occurrence requires cessation.
action.recommendation: No dose now; after recovery, use the next lower verified dose level (300 → 250 → 200 mg twice daily). Confirm prior reductions and occurrence history with the Consultant.

rules.explanation: Delay olaparib for ANC <1 or platelets <100 ×10⁹/L until recovery, then restart one level lower per NCCP Table 1. Check prior reductions and occurrence history; the fourth occurrence requires cessation.

action.message: Febrile neutropenia requires urgent assessment and interruption until recovery. NCCP calls for a lower restart dose; grade 4 may require two levels and the fourth occurrence requires cessation. Confirm grade and previous dose before calculating any restart.
action.recommendation: No dose now; establish recovery, grade, previous dose and occurrence history before restart.

action.message: Grade 3 febrile neutropenia: urgent treatment, delay until recovery, then restart one dose level lower. Check occurrence history; the fourth occurrence requires cessation.

action.message: Grade 4 febrile neutropenia: urgent treatment and delay until recovery. NCCP says consider a two-level reduction on restart; this is a Consultant decision, not an automatic restart prescription.

eligibility: Adult first-line maintenance of FIGO III–IV advanced epithelial ovarian/fallopian-tube/primary-peritoneal cancer after complete or partial response to platinum chemotherapy plus bevacizumab
Validated HRD positivity: BRCA1/2 mutation and/or genomic instability; HRD unknown is not positive
High-grade serous/endometrioid histology, or other epithelial non-mucinous ovarian histology with germline BRCA mutation
Six to nine platinum-taxane cycles; bevacizumab in the last three platinum cycles, or at least two bevacizumab cycles when interval debulking surgery applies
No evidence of disease/complete or partial response, ECOG 0–1, adequate marrow and organ function
exclusions: Prior PARP inhibitor or known hypersensitivity to the relevant component/excipients
Pregnancy; breastfeeding restrictions follow both agents, including six months after bevacizumab
Major surgery within four weeks or wounds not fully healed for bevacizumab
Relevant CHO-cell or recombinant-antibody hypersensitivity for bevacizumab

supportive_care.emetogenic_potential: Moderate to high; refer to local policy.
premedications_to_consider: Proton pump inhibitor according to local policy

contraception.female_patient: Use two reliable complementary methods before/during olaparib and for 6 months after its last dose. Bevacizumab also requires contraception during treatment and for 6 months after its last dose. Use the later applicable date and review non-hormonal choices where appropriate.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Continuous oral olaparib is moderate-to-high emetic potential; bevacizumab is minimal. Consider a local antiemetic/PPI plan and check CYP3A interactions; no automatic multidrug IV prophylaxis bundle.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
supportive_care.breastfeeding: Do not breastfeed during either drug. Apply both post-treatment intervals: 1 month after olaparib and 6 months after bevacizumab, using the later permitted date.

administration.notes: Continuous tablets, without a rest week. Swallow whole. Duration follows the separate olaparib disease-status decision.
Every 21 days. First infusion 90 minutes; second 60 if first tolerated; subsequent 30 if preceding infusion tolerated. Maximum 15 months total includes earlier chemotherapy-combination treatment.

baseline: Confirm the selected NCCP suffix, first-line setting, response to platinum plus bevacizumab, validated HRD result and detailed eligibility
FBC, renal and liver profile; previous treatment-related Hb/neutrophil/platelet toxicity recovered to grade 1 or better before starting olaparib
Urine dipstick/protein and blood pressure; cardiovascular history and examination
Review surgery/wound healing, bleeding, thrombosis, fistula/perforation risk and full medicines list

baseline_conditional.test: Pregnancy test; consider repeat tests as indicated

baseline_conditional.condition: Previous anthracycline treatment or chest-wall irradiation

regular_conditional.test: INR weekly until stable, then before each cycle

monitoring.disease_monitoring: According to the supervising Consultant plan; record separate component start dates and all prior bevacizumab exposure.

drug_interaction_support.general_rule: Concomitant strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors are not recommended; consider alternatives. If unavoidable, apply Table 4 dose reductions.

source_conflicts_v08463.renal_exact30: NCCP includes 30 in its 30–50 band; EMA defines ≤30 as severe. Manual source reconciliation, no automatic dose.
source_conflicts_v08463.renal_below30_dialysis_child_pugh_c: NCCP says consider 50% of original olaparib; current EMA does not routinely recommend use. Retain both and require individual review.
source_conflicts_v08463.protein_exact2: NCCP Table 4 explicitly includes exactly 2 g/24 h in proceed. EMA 4.8 describes trial practice at ≥2 but is not a universal contrary prescribing mandate.
source_conflicts_v08463.uncontrolled_bp_notation: NCCP initiation caution says sustained >150/100 while on antihypertensive treatment without defining numerical AND/OR logic. Clinical control/symptom assessment is required.
source_conflicts_v08463.no_bevacizumab_reduction: There is no bevacizumab dose-reduction ladder; use suspension/discontinuation as appropriate.
source_conflicts_v08463.breastfeeding: Combination applies both clocks: olaparib one month and bevacizumab six months after each last dose.
